text:
anais: Quick design check — thinking about how we handle deep links into the console when the sidebar is regrouped. Two concerns: 1) preserve a stable URL for bookmarked workflows, 2) keep keyboard/skip-link accessibility when panels collapse. Thoughts?

kevin: Love the questions. my worry is state vs route — if sidebar groups collapse client-side only, deep links might land on a different visual state than the creator expected. Recommend canonical route + state hash.

sara: From PM POV: users bookmark a specific model page or eval dashboard. They expect the URL to open the same panel open/closed. But we should avoid huge query strings. Could we encode minimal state (e.g., `panel=open` or `group=deploy`) ? :thinking_face:

luis: technically doable. simplest: route stays /models/:id and we add optional fragment `#group=perform` or `?panel=insights`. fragments avoid server parsing but are harder for analytics. Example config snippet:
```
// route definitions (sketch)
{ path: "/models/:id", component: ModelPage }
// client reads location.hash or query to restore side panel state
```

molly: accessibility nits: make sure "Skip to main" goes to the same logical content even if a secondary nav is programmatically expanded. Also, breadcrumbs should be properly announced by screen readers when deep-linking into nested views. Consider `aria-current` updates after client-side navigation.

anais: good call. on breadcrumbs — do we prefer representing grouping in breadcrumb trail (e.g., Projects > Models > Model X) or keep breadcrumbs flat and surface group context in the sidebar only?

kevin: I'd keep breadcrumbs semantic, not purely UI grouping. Breadcrumbs = hierarchy of resource, not the sidebar's grouping. Sidebar can show grouping separately. That avoids brittle links if sidebar regroups later.

sara: +1. Also request: add a small UX for when a link lands on a collapsed group — show a toast: "Showing result in X group — expanded for you" with an action link "Remember preference" (opt-in).

luis: implementation note: if we auto-expand group on deep-link, we should add a short URL canonicalization step for analytics: when landing, push a canonical URL to history (no reload) without the transient state, or set a `utm`-like flag so we know it was a deep-link expansion.

molly: keyboard flow: ensure focus lands inside the expanded panel and not on the sidebar toggle. Use `element.focus()` after expansion and set `aria-live=\"polite\"` for the toast. Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver.

anais: action items: 1) kevin/luis: prototype route+hash pattern and canonicalization (small spike) 2) molly: write a checklist for focus/aria behaviors 3) sara: collect top 10 bookmarked URLs from analytics to validate patterns. I'll mock the toast copy and microcopy alternatives. Anyone want to add copy suggestions now?

kevin: draft toast copy: "Navigated to Model X inside the Performance group — group expanded for you. [Remember this setting]"

sara: maybe shorter: "Opened in Performance — group expanded. [Remember]"

molly: prefer explicit: "Expanded Performance group to show Model X." (better for screen readers)
